title: Glasgow Tower
geometryBasis: The 60-point mapped circular enclosure locates the tower pivot and its 6.193 m radius. The October 2023 cleared original controls the tower silhouette, main shafts, horizontal brace spacing, pod and antenna.
sectionBasis: The operator documents the 127 m tower top and 105 m viewing floor. The two outriggers and stair shaft form a triangle in plan. The depth, width, structure behind the reference elevation and base details are estimated. The fixed turntable bearing is approximate.
limitations: Static 2023 exterior preview with an estimated turntable angle. The tower can rotate and its exact bearing on October 1 is unknown.
The main heights and circular base are measured controls. The shaft sections, opposite-side details, support sections and visible base details are reconstructed estimates.
The original Pacific Quay elevation field is preserved. Exposed ground contact and the turntable collar use approximate paving grade.
